description: Synthetic gold résumé snippets with the skills and credentials a careful human reader would expect a provider to suggest. Fictional text only; no real people, employers or credential numbers.

cases.title: Data engineer, explicit skill names
cases.text:
Data engineer for a fictional logistics company. Built SQL pipelines and ETL jobs in Python. Defined data quality checks and data modeling standards for the warehouse.
Certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.

cases.title: Cloud architect with a credential in progress
cases.text:
Cloud architect. Led AWS architecture reviews, wrote infrastructure as code with Terraform, designed cloud networking and managed identity & access for three accounts.
Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional; CompTIA Security+.
Pursuing CISSP.

cases.title: Negated and absent skills must not be suggested
cases.text: Comfortable reading dashboards but no Power BI experience. Not familiar with Python development. Strong in statistical analysis and data visualization for survey results.

cases.title: Maintenance planner
cases.text:
Maintenance planner. Ran qualification planning, work package readiness and fleet sustainment reviews. Wrote technical work instructions for repeat evolutions.
Certifications: OSHA 30-Hour Training.

cases.title: Paraphrased evidence (keyword matching is expected to miss some)
cases.text: Coached junior staff every week and taught new hires how the build works. Organized the sprint ceremonies for two squads.

cases.title: Security analyst
cases.text:
Security analyst. Owned security controls, threat modeling, vulnerability triage, security documentation and access reviews for a fictional records system.
Certifications: CompTIA CySA+.

cases.title: No work evidence at all
cases.text: Hobbies include gardening, chess and long-distance cycling. References available on request.

cases.title: Delivery automation
cases.text: Maintained GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows. Added test automation, PowerShell automation for deployments and API design reviews.

cases.title: Delivery lead with project credentials
cases.text:
Delivery lead. Kept the risk register, ran roadmap planning and agile facilitation for a fictional product team.
Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP); Certified ScrumMaster.
